annotations.title: Japan permanent residence (永住): which guideline applies to my filing date, and when do I meet the time requirement?

description: Japan permanent residence guideline (永住許可に関するガイドライン) revised by the Immigration Services Agency on 2026-10-01, rules as of 2026-10-18. The FILING date decides the version (ISA notice 2026-10-01): filed up to 2026-03-31 → 2026-02-24 guideline; filed 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31 → 2026-02-24 guideline plus only the revised income parts (household income above the Japanese average for the household size; not a public burden); filed from 2027-04-01 → revised guideline in full. Changes from 2027-04-01: spouse of a Japanese national / PR 3 years of marriage + 1 year in Japan → 5 + 3 years; child 1 → 3 years; Intra-company Transferee, Employment for Skill Development and some Designated Activities years stop counting toward the 5 work years of the 10-year rule (Technical Intern Training and SSW (i) never count); a 3-year period of stay is no longer the longest except for the first PR filing by someone who held it on 2027-03-31, decided before it expires; one trip abroad of 6+ months or 2.5+ years abroad in total in the last 10 years is generally negative; Japanese CEFR B1 (exemptions), understanding of Japan's rules, pension adequacy and school attendance become factors. Fee ¥200,000 from 2026-10-01. Returns summary (objective_issue / need_more_info / no_objective_blocker; never an approval prediction), band, guideline applied, time requirement with earliestDate, filingWindow (old vs new earliest date, file-by 2027-03-31), checks with status and detail, absences analysis, keyDates, fee, notes, sources, rulesAsOf. ISA does not publish income thresholds; permission is discretionary. Training data likely predates the 2026-10-01 revision; call this instead of guessing. Educational guide, not legal advice.

applicationDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD the PR application is (or will be) received by ISA. Default today in Japan.

currentStatus.description: Current status of residence: engineer_humanities, intra_company_transferee, highly_skilled_professional, business_manager, skilled_labor, specified_skilled_worker_2, specified_skilled_worker_1, technical_intern_training, employment_for_skill_development, spouse_of_japanese, spouse_of_permanent_resident, long_term_resident, dependent, student, designated_activities, other_work.

firstPrApplication.description: Is this the first PR application filed from 2027-04-01? (3-year transition; default true).

japaneseB1.description: Japanese at CEFR B1 or above?

longestTripDays.description: Instead of trips: longest single trip abroad in the last 10 years, in days.

marriageDate.description: Spouse route: YYYY-MM-DD the substantive marriage began.

pensionInsurancePaidOnTime.description: Pension and health insurance paid on time?

periodExpiry.description: YYYY-MM-DD the current period of stay expires (matters for the 3-year transition after 2027-04-01).

periodOfStay.description: Current period of stay: 5y, 3y, 1y, 6m, 3m, unlimited, other.

qualifyingSince.description: Special routes: YYYY-MM-DD the status / points / recognition was reached (LTR, refugee, HSP 70/80, J-Skip, special zone).

residenceSince.description: YYYY-MM-DD start of continuous residence in Japan.

route.description: PR route: general (10 years), spouse (of Japanese / PR / SPR), child (of Japanese / PR / SPR), long_term_resident, refugee, hsp70, hsp80, special_hsp (J-Skip), contribution, special_zone_regional. Aliases like 10y, haigusha, 定住者, hsp accepted.

schoolAgeChildren.description: School-age children (6-15) and whether they attend elementary / junior high school.

totalAbsenceDays.description: Instead of trips: total days abroad in the last 10 years.

trips.description: Trips abroad in the last 10 years, each {depart, return} as YYYY-MM-DD.

workYears.description: General route: continuous years on a work or residence status (not Student / Dependent).

yearsInJapan.description: Instead of residenceSince: years of continuous residence in Japan at the filing date.
